title: $570 Million in 15 Months
description:
570 million dollars. Her makeup brand's first 15 months.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Rihanna: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rihanna
- Wikipedia: Fenty Beauty: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fenty_Beauty

From Wikipedia (Rihanna): in 2003 she formed a trio with two classmates in Barbados and auditioned for producer Evan Rogers; fourteen number-one singles on the Billboard Hot 100; the first female musician to reach billionaire status. From Wikipedia (Fenty Beauty): launched September 8, 2017 with LVMH, known for its wide range of skin tones, its foundation in high demand from release; Forbes reported US$570 million in revenue after 15 months, in 2018, and valued the business at US$2.8 billion. Not financial advice.
